data.name: Light and Shadow - Schatten über Empyria
data.detailed_description:
Overview

After a severe shipwreck, you awaken without memories on the shores of an unknown world. Your name, your past – everything seems lost. But your adventure has only just begun. Light and Shadow - Schatten über Empyria is an epic indie RPG that grants you ultimate freedom: Follow the gripping main story or write your very own destiny.

Will you banish the looming evil, or plunge the world into darkness yourself?

  • Limitless Character Progression: Train your skills to the absolute maximum! With a level cap of 999, there are hardly any limits to your power.

  • The Arena Awaits: Prove your combat prowess and fight to earn the exclusive "Gladiator" class. Use your newly acquired skills to stand against the forces of darkness in the open world.

  • A Place to Call Home: Fighting isn't everything. Create your own sanctuary, build a house, and cultivate your own crops to harvest valuable resources.

  • The Power of the Guild: Join an influential guild, meet unique companions, and assemble a team capable of taking on any danger.

  • Tricky Dungeons & Puzzles: Explore a multitude of dangerous dungeons filled with secrets, monsters, and puzzles that will challenge your mind.

Experience the World Of Light and Shadows!

data.short_description: Stranded and without memories, you awaken in the world of Empyria. Join a powerful guild, recruit loyal companions, and make a fateful choice: Will you save the world from the shadows – or plunge it into ruin once and for all?
